site.title: Shvaas Kriya Retreat | Rishikesh & Online Sanctuary
site.description: A space to reconnect through breath, sound & stillness. Mindful sessions, soulful retreats in Rishikesh, and learning journeys rooted in presence.
site.location: Tapovan Riverside & Partner Retreat Sanctuaries, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India

hero.badge: Rishikesh & Online Sanctuary • Breathe · Listen · Reconnect
hero.headline: Welcome to Shvaas Kriya Retreat
hero.subheadline: A Space to Reconnect Through Breath, Sound & Stillness
hero.body: Step away from the noise of everyday life and make room for yourself. Explore mindful sessions, soulful retreats in Rishikesh, and learning journeys rooted in breath, sound, and presence.

whatIsSoundHealing.headline: Sound as Medicine in the Himalayas
whatIsSoundHealing.subheadline: Sound healing at Shvaas Kriya Retreat is a transformative practice designed to restore balance and inner peace through the therapeutic power of sound vibrations. Using instruments such as Tibetan singing bowls, gongs, and chimes, this modality works to realign your body's energy frequencies and induce deep mental clarity.
whatIsSoundHealing.quote: In the quietude of Rishikesh along the sacred Ganga, every harmonic wave reconnects you to the pulse of creation.

sanctuaryAltar.headline: Experience The Singing Bowl In Real-Time
sanctuaryAltar.description: Interact with our procedurally crafted Tibetan bronze vessel. Strike the bowl, adjust the Solfeggio frequency to match any of the seven chakras, and feel the visual and acoustic resonance ripple outwards.

offersShowcase.headline: Experiences that meet you where you are.
offersShowcase.subheadline: Find the session, retreat, or learning journey that feels right for you.

offers.title: Shvaas Kriya Sessions — Online & Offline
offers.desc: Make time to pause, breathe, and reconnect through guided sessions designed to support a more mindful relationship with yourself. Join from wherever you are, or experience the practice in person in Rishikesh.

offers.title: Shvaas Kriya TTC
offers.desc: Deepen your personal practice and explore the foundations of Shvaas Kriya through a structured teacher training journey. Learn, practise, and grow with intention in Rishikesh.

offers.title: Sound Healing Sessions
offers.desc: Enter a space of deep listening and relaxation through resonant sounds and mindful stillness. Give yourself permission to slow down and simply be.

offers.title: Aqua Sound Healing Sessions
offers.desc: Experience sound in a unique water-based setting, where water and resonant sound come together to create an immersive moment of calm.

offers.title: Sound Healing TTC
offers.desc: Explore the art and practice of sound healing, build your understanding of sound instruments, and develop the skills to guide sound experiences for others.

teacherTraining.headline: Sound Healing & Shvaas Kriya Teacher Training in Rishikesh
teacherTraining.subheadline: Step into the sacred foothills of Rishikesh by the Ganga. Train under experienced practitioners to facilitate profound individual therapies and transcendental group sound baths with authentic Tibetan singing bowls.

modules.title: Acoustic Science & The Seven Sacred Metals
modules.desc: The metallurgy and harmonics of antique Himalayan singing bowls, binaural frequency math, and brainwave entrainment (Beta, Alpha, Theta, Delta).

modules.title: 1-on-1 Clinical Sound Therapy Protocols
modules.desc: Hands-on training for direct placement on the physical body, spinal alignment, releasing myofascial stress, and on-body massage techniques.

modules.title: Aura Scanning & Crystal Pendulum Dowsing
modules.desc: Subtle biofield diagnosis, identifying energetic blockages, auric tear repair, and boundary protection for healers.

modules.title: Gong Baths & Group Sound Immersion Mastery
modules.desc: Playing techniques for large Chau, Wind, and Symphonic gongs, Koshi chimes, tingshas, and designing transformational group sound journeys.

reviews.name: Elena Rostova
reviews.comment: I came to Rishikesh carrying months of severe burnout and insomnia from corporate work. When the master placed the large bronze singing bowl on my chest and struck it, I felt tears flowing uncontrollably as all the frozen grief dissolved. That night I slept 9 uninterrupted hours for the first time in two years.

reviews.name: Julian & Sarah Vance
reviews.comment: A profoundly sacred experience for our 10th anniversary. The dual singing bowls tuned to the heart chakra (639Hz) created an acoustic embrace that felt out of this realm. The quiet tea ceremony in the Rishikesh riverside sanctuary afterward cemented an unforgettable memory.

reviews.name: Dr. Aarav Mehta
reviews.comment: As a neuroscientist and longtime meditator, I was astonished by the precision with which the frequencies triggered deep theta brainwave states. You can genuinely feel the physical waves reorganizing tension in your spine and nervous system. Outstanding authenticity.

reviews.name: Chiara Moretti
reviews.comment: Completing the teacher training at Shvaas Kriya Retreat in Rishikesh was life-altering. The master teachers do not merely teach you how to hit bowls; they teach you how to listen with your subtle field, how to hold space for others, and how to heal. I now lead sound baths back home in Italy with absolute confidence.

faqs.question: Where do Shvaas Kriya retreats take place?
faqs.answer: Retreats are curated with selected hospitality partners and spaces in and around Rishikesh. The venue is shared for each retreat.

faqs.question: Are Shvaas Kriya sessions available online and offline?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both online and in-person options are offered, subject to the current schedule.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Shvaas Kriya TTC and Sound Healing TTC?
faqs.answer: They are separate training offerings. Course details, curriculum, duration, and outcomes are provided on their respective training overviews.

faqs.question: What is Aqua Sound Healing?
faqs.answer: It is a unique water-based sound experience where water and resonant sound come together to create an immersive moment of calm. Review specific session details for format, venue, and safety.

faqs.question: What is included in a retreat?
faqs.answer: Inclusions vary by package. Each retreat schedule lists confirmed accommodation, sattvic meals, guided breathwork, sound healing sessions, local Ganga excursions, and transfers.

faqs.question: How do I book or enquire?
faqs.answer: Use the booking form on this site, reach out directly on WhatsApp, or send an enquiry to our Rishikesh team for current schedules, availability, and next steps.
